chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Cincinnati and the Graystone Ballroom (second version)
summary: A French acquaintance in Cincinnati; the Graystone Ballroom and a week in a downtown hotel.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Ralph Sulay (phonetic spelling). Who was Ralph Sulay?
A French guy that I met.
No, he was in Cincinnati. We would go with them to Cincinnati.
That's right; Lexington isn't that far away.
We went to Cincinnati and we played the Graystone Hotel--the Graystone Ballroom.
You were there for quite a while.
We were; that was a nice spot.
Then we went down to a hotel, downtown, but we were only there for about a week.
Yes. I forgot the name of the hotel.
What happened that you were only there for a week?
I don't remember whether that's all they wanted us for, because the band was still a great band.
